publisher: City of Litchfield Park (zoning via AZGeo-hosted layer)
notes: Parcel-based layer: one feature per parcel with the parcel zoning in CITY_ZONING (ZONING also present). No district polygons or district name attribute, so zone_name repeats the code. Hosted by the state AZGeo ArcGIS organization (sjohnson_azgeo) and used by the Litchfield Park ArcGIS web app; used because no district layer is published. City limits only.
